cues: The germ layer table, the most asked table in this unit.
Ectoderm makes the skin and the entire nervous system, including the retina and lens.
Mesoderm makes muscle, bone, blood, the heart, the kidneys and the gonads.
Endoderm lines the gut and makes the liver, pancreas, the lining of the lungs, and the thyroid.
